AUTHOR: Zhang, P; Yang, ZY; Yu, H; Tu, W; Gao, CC; Wang, Y
TITLE: RUSNet: Robust fish segmentation in underwater videos based on adaptive selection of optical flow
REGION: Tropical Australia (DeepFish) and SE Queensland estuaries (Seagrass)
DATA: Joint DeepFish-segmentation + Seagrass (Luderick) video datasets (31 clips, 4409 frames); DeepFish official segmentation split (620 images); MoCA-Mask for qualitative ablation
V_EV: Sec 2: 'DeepFish and Seagrass have more severe brightness attenuation and water turbidity, as well as complex backgrounds, such as floating dense seaweeds.'
D2: joint dataset: 12 clips/3107 train, 8 clips/693 val, 11 clips/609 test; DeepFish official 310/124/186
D_EV: Sec 2: 'From the joint dataset, 12 video clips with 3107 images are selected for training, 8 video clips with 693 images ... validation, and 11 video clips with 609 images ... testing.'
R_EV: Sec 3.3/3.4: models trained and tested within the joint DeepFish-Seagrass dataset and separately within DeepFish ('we use this approach to train and test the model')
E_EV: Abstract/Sec 3: only 'mean pixel accuracy (mPA) and mean intersection over union (mIoU)' reported
ARCH: RUSNet: two-stream RGB + RAFT optical flow, MiT-b1 encoders, global flow-quality evaluation, MDA decoder, multi-output selective fusion
NOTE: Two designs: joint DeepFish+Seagrass split by video clips (main comparison, coded) and DeepFish official split (random per-habitat image split 50/20/30) for robustness test. Text also says 'All datasets are divided ... at a ratio of 6:2:2', which conflicts with clip counts - verify. MoCA-Mask (camouflage, 1539 frames 'for testing') used only for qualitative ablation figure; training source for that test unclear -> R1 coded N. Selective fusion uses internal confidence (MAE comparison), no threshold reported.
